svg.aria-label: ANY PAGE: A small loader element puts a launcher on any page. The widget app runs in an isolated iframe. DESKTOP AND MOBILE: Floating button on desktop, bottom sheet on mobile. Position, theme and language come from studio settings. SIGN-IN FIRST: Signed-in users only. Logged-out visitors see a sign-in prompt
